<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (M+1 ≈14 % of base, M+2 ≈1 % of base, rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks) the pattern matches the binomial distribution expected for a molecule containing many carbon atoms (≈13 C). No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present, and the intensities are far too high for typical contributions from N, O, or H isotopes. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
